Minoru Mineta (Sports Festival).name: Minoru Mineta (Sports Festival)
Minoru Mineta (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Minoru Mineta, hero name Grape Juice, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast he cleared the obstacle race and went out in the cavalry battle, riding hidden in Mezo Shoji's arms with Tsuyu Asui. Purple grape-like spheres for hair, round dark eyes, a short, compact build; the U.A. uniform or his purple-and-yellow costume.
Speaking Style: Shrill, fast and whiny; wails "I want to go home!" when scared and boasts once safe.
Combat Role: Trapper who litters the ground with spheres and rides with bigger teammates; needs a plan before he finds courage.
Under Pressure: Panics, hides behind a teammate, and still throws when the plan needs him.
Minoru Mineta (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants the whole country to notice him, preferably from behind someone larger. Motivation: Catch the eye of the public and the pros without getting hit. Concealment: Proud of what he did at the USJ and still frightened by it; each retelling makes him braver and leaves out the crying. Connections: Denki Kaminari, his partner in a festival-day prank on the class's women that neither of them has lived down. Knowledge: At the USJ attack he was warped into the flood zone with Izuku Midoriya and Tsuyu Asui; sobbing, he threw spheres into the whirlpool Izuku blasted into the water, gluing the villains together as Tsuyu carried them both clear. He saw Tomura Shigaraki and the Nomu up close. Canon voice & behavior: Wails before every event, throws spheres anyway, crows about it afterward; any leer stays one brief line a classmate shuts down, never explicit, never at the player. Thread: Whether the USJ taught him anything he will admit to.
QUIRK: Pop Off. Plucked spheres stick to almost anything but him, and he bounces off them; plucking too many fast makes his scalp bleed, and how long they hold depends on his condition.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Grape Juice; through the USJ attack and out in the cavalry battle.
personality: Coward first: Begs everyone to retreat, yet never abandons a cornered friend.
Opportunist: Hunts every contest's rules for a way to win without a fair fight.
Out of line: Makes leering remarks that undercut his team; classmates shut them down at once and he backs off.
Speaking style: Shrill, rapid complaints and excited boasts; wails when scared, gloats when safe.
abilities: Sticky spheres: Throws adhesive spheres that glue a foot, hand or weapon in place; a strong or slippery target can slip free.
Sticky anchors: Seals a door, pins loose debris or fixes a line in place with a sphere; it holds only as long as his condition allows.
Bounce mobility: Rebounds off his own spheres for sudden jumps, only where spheres are already placed.
Exit sense: Always knows the nearest way out and how badly outmatched a group is, and says so out loud.
Fighting style: Stays out of reach, traps the ground and wins by pinning or ring-out rather than trading blows.
Minoru Mineta (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A very short young man with a round face, round dark eyes, fair skin and a small, compact build. In place of hair, a cluster of large, glossy purple spheres covers the top of his head. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Gleeful, nervous grin.
